Naw but seriously turn off computer lie down, fizzy/soft drinks do NOT make you hyper that is just a rumour, stop thinking you are hyper and that you can't get to sleep and you will fall asleep. Don't think about trying to sleep either it will come eventually. Niight night!

replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Grab a glass of milk, then pour a spoonful of honey into it. Heat it in the microwave for ~30 seconds. If it's not warm enough, keep it in the microwave for longer.

So soothing.
